title: A Median Version of Hardy's Inequality
summary: Motivated by a discrete inequality problem proposed by Duanyang Zhang as Problem 6 of the 2022 Spring NSMO, we prove a median version of Hardy's inequality. For a nonnegative function $f\in L^p(0,\infty)$, $p>1$, let $A(t)$ be the average of $f$ over $(0,t)$, and let $M(t)$ be the lower median of $f$ over $(0,t)$. We show that \[ \int_0^\infty |M(t)-A(t)|^p\,dt \leq 2^{1-p}\left(\frac p{p-1}\right)^p \int_0^\infty f(t)^p\,dt, \] and that the constant is best possible.
